scope: Web form keyboard changes and clearer capital-letter feedback.

topics.title: Type in web forms
details: Press E or Shift+E to reach a text box and start typing. You no longer need to press Enter first.

Enter in a single-line text box now uses the site’s own default action, such as Next, Continue, or Log in. Tab saves your answer and moves to the next control. The website still checks required answers.
Buttons announce Loading page and then the page result. The extra Pressed announcement has been removed.
If a button leaves the page unchanged, Companion says so. If the site returns an error, it reports that error. It does not click again on its own.

topics.title: Hear one capital cue
details: Open Verbosity in Options. Find When encountering capital letters. Choose raise pitch, lower pitch, play a sound, or do nothing. Your saved choice still works.
The cue happens once when you reach or type a capital letter. The delayed phonetic name uses your normal pitch and does not play a second tone.

topics.title: PayPal sign-in
details: The keyboard changes are tested with forms that change from email to password. A successful live PayPal sign-in and human check inside Voice Companion have not been confirmed.
